prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [adoption, redesign] Grid layout redesign for photo upload screen: Redesign the photo upload screen into a structured multi-card grid layout to better guide custom pet photo submission.
   config: {"upload_photos": {"layout": "grid"}}
1: [adoption, new_screen] Pet naming step insertion: Insert a dedicated pet naming screen right after custom photo upload to personalize pet setup before generating the adoption certificate.
   config: {"new_pet_naming": {"headline": "Name Your New Pet", "body": "Give your desktop companion a unique name.", "layout": "centered"}, "_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "new_pet_naming", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"]}
2: [adoption, new_flow] Stage layout redesign for pet pick friend screen: Rebuild the pet selection screen into a stage layout presentation highlighting featured pet avatars.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"layout": "stage"}}
3: [finish, redesign] Split layout redesign for home intro screen: Redesign the home intro screen into a split layout presenting desktop placement settings alongside pet activation controls.
   config: {"home_intro": {"layout": "split"}}
4: [choose_path, redesign] Carousel layout redesign for choose path screen: Redesign the path selection screen into a full-width swipeable carousel screen.
   config: {"choose_path": {"layout": "carousel"}}
5: [sign_in, hint] Existing account pet restoration hint on sign-in: Display a hint explaining that signing in restores existing desktop pets and settings.
   config: {"sign_in": {"hint": "Signing into your registered account automatically restores your previously saved pets and progress."}}
6: [home, wait_info] Desktop overlay initialization status hint on waiting screen: Display status updates about desktop overlay initialization and screen rendering during pet setup.
   config: {"waiting": {"hint": "Initializing desktop overlay and rendering companion graphics..."}}
7: [home, notification] Desktop pet launch system notification toggle: Add a system notification toggle on the waiting screen so users get notified when pet initialization completes.
   config: {"waiting": {"notify_when_ready": true}}
8: [sign_in, incentive] Cloud storage pet memory backup incentive callout: Add a visual badge explaining that sign-in enables cloud backup for pet personality traits and memories.
   config: {"sign_in": {"components": [{"type": "badge", "text": "Cloud Sync Enabled: Automatically backs up pet traits and progress", "style": "highlight"}]}}
9: [finish, hint] Desktop pet tray icon and control hint on home intro: Add a hint explaining how to locate and control the pet via system tray and desktop shortcuts on the final screen.
   config: {"home_intro": {"hint": "Control your pet anytime via the system tray icon or right-clicking directly on your desktop companion."}}
